text.tspan: Guidance for 5G Network Anomaly Detection and
Automated Root Cause Analysis on AWS
Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus applies Random Cut Forest anomaly detection to a live 5G core. When an anomaly fires, an AWS Lambda function
forwards the alert to the AWS DevOps Agent, which autonomously investigates and identifies the failing network function.
